extDesc.message: Split Firefox into several panes inside one tab — pick a layout like Windows 11 Snap (Win+Z).

hintAlready.message: This tab is already split — pick a new layout

hintMulti.message: $1 tabs selected — click the pane for this tab

hintSingle.message: Click the pane for this tab · fill the other panes later (Ctrl+click tabs first to add several at once)

urlPh.message: Type a web address and press Enter

popOut.message: Open this pane as a normal tab

splitRight.message: Split this pane left/right (right-click inside a page → Snap Split for any side)

maxPanes.message: You can split into at most $1 panes

fileBlocked.message: Firefox doesn't allow opening file:/// here — use “Open local file…” or drag the file into a pane

grip.message: Drag onto another pane to swap

blockedTitle.message: Firefox doesn't allow this site in a split pane

blockedBody.message: $1 is a Mozilla site (add-ons store / Firefox account). Firefox protects it, so no extension can show it inside another page — open it as a normal tab.

chooserHint.message: Or pick a tab for this pane · you can also drop a file here

noTabs.message: No other web tabs in this window
